For the reviewer, one gap in this round's saturation fix that no run of mine can turn into a wrong verdict, so it is not recorded as a failure. collectMeta (replay_record.go:182) reads the cgroup quota from /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max alone, which is cgroup v2. This pod, the shape the README's Requirements name, runs cgroup v1: /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max does not exist, /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu/cpu.cfs_quota_us is 300000 and cpu.cfs_period_us 100000, so the quota is 3 cores and meta.json records cgroup_cpu_max "". The cgroup arm of saturationCores is therefore never consulted here. Every verdict I measured is still right, because nproc 2 is below that quota, but the protection the reviewer asked for -- a quota below nproc -- would not hold on a v1 pod given one core. Reading cpu.cfs_quota_us and cpu.cfs_period_us when cpu.max is absent is the whole fix.
